title: Monitored free fermions under periodic driving
summary: We investigate analytically and numerically a one-dimensional periodically driven free-fermionic system subjected to monitoring of the local particle density. Based on the analytical approach that describes the long-wavelength physics of the time-dependent Hamiltonian in the field-theoretical language using the nonlinear sigma-model (NLSM), we reveal that driving does not alter the universality class of the problem. As a consequence, the system retains the area-law behavior in the thermodynamic limit, with an intermediate diffusive regime giving rise to logarithmic growth of entanglement…
